#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    auto mod_add = [m](int x, int y) {
        x += y;
        if (x >= m) x -= m;
        return x;
    };

    auto mod_mul = [m](int x, int y) {
        return (int)((x * 1ll * y) % m);
    };

    vector<int> factorial(n + 1);
    factorial[0] = n;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        factorial[i] = mod_mul(factorial[i - 1], n - i);
    }

    int size = n * (n - 1) + 1;
    int middle = (n * (n - 1)) / 2;
    vector<int> dp(size, 0);
    dp[middle] = 1;
    int answer = 0;

    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        int c = n - 1 - i;
        vector<int> temp = dp;
        fill(dp.begin(), dp.end(), 0);
        int limit = (c * (c - 1)) / 2;
        int count = 0;

        // First part: accumulate contributions from negative cur
        for (int cur = -c; cur < 0; ++cur) {
            int pairs = c + cur + 1;  // c - abs(cur) + 1
            int start = middle - cur + 1;
            int end = middle + limit;
            for (int j = start; j <= end; ++j) {
                count = mod_add(count, mod_mul(temp[j], pairs));
            }
        }

        // Update answer
        int add = (i == 0) ? 1 : factorial[i - 1];
        answer = mod_add(answer, mod_mul(count, add));

        // Second part: propagate dp
        for (int j = middle - limit; j <= middle + limit; ++j) {
            for (int cur = -c; cur <= c; ++cur) {
                int pairs = c - (cur < 0 ? -cur : cur) + 1;
                int idx = j + cur;
                dp[idx] = mod_add(dp[idx], mod_mul(pairs, temp[j]));
            }
        }
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
